name: HTML - Complete Document
description: Create a proper HTML document structure

rules.text: Create a complete HTML document with <html>, <head>, and <body> tags
rules.hint: A proper HTML document has structure: <html> (root), <head> (metadata), <body> (visible content). Wrap everything: <html><head></head><body>[your content]</body></html>

checkParams.function: (code) => { const hasHtml = code.includes('<html>') && code.includes('</html>'); const hasHead = code.includes('<head>') && code.includes('</head>'); const hasBody = code.includes('<body>') && code.includes('</body>'); return hasHtml && hasHead && hasBody; }

rules.text: Add a <title> tag inside the <head> section
rules.hint: The title appears in the browser tab. Add it inside head: <head><title>My Page Title</title></head>

rules.text: Include at least a heading, paragraph, and list in the body
rules.hint: Put all your visible content in the <body> section. Include at least one heading (h1-h6), one paragraph (<p>), and one list (<ul> with <li> items).
